cases.customer_question: Is it possible to control when a product becomes publicly visible after Bluetooth SIG listing?
cases.actual_issue: Understanding constraints on Product Publication Date in the qualification process.
cases.consultant_answer: The publication timing can be specified during registration, but it is limited to a maximum of 90 days after registration and is generally not changeable afterward.
cases.final_recommendation: Plan the listing timing carefully and set the publication date during submission, ensuring it falls within the allowed 90-day window.
